description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents…“Dock 'N Dune,” a 5-bedroom lakefront in Seagrove Beach, perfect for family getaways or friend reunions. Wake up to Eastern Lake views, relax by your private heated pool and spa, or enjoy Gulf views just a 3-min walk from the beach. With space for 20 guests, 7 bikes, and access to 30A trails, shops, and charm, this home blends adventure and relaxation. From sunrise coffees on the dock to evenings filled with laughter, your unforgettable escape awaits. Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Lakefront Living: Enjoy serene mornings and peaceful evenings with stunning views of Eastern Lake from multiple decks and your own private dock—a true escape into nature’s tranquility.Gulf Views: Experience breathtaking sunsets from the rooftop deck, where every evening feels like a postcard-perfect moment.Private Heated Pool & Spa: Relax in ultimate luxury with a heated pool and spa overlooking the lake—perfect for unwinding after a day of adventure.Steps to the Beach: Just a short 3-minute walk to 2 beach access points, making it easy to sink your toes into the sand and soak up the sun.Room for Everyone: With 5 spacious bedrooms, including fun bunk areas, this home is designed for large groups or families to connect and create lasting memories.Outdoor Entertainment: Gather around the fire pit for s’mores, enjoy a BBQ feast, or simply relax in the ample outdoor seating—perfect for lively evenings under the stars.7 Bikes Included: Explore the charm of 30A trails or nearby Seaside with ease, adding a touch of adventure to your stay.Eager to Read More? Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests: "Fantastic views and a perfect location! Our kids (ages 21 to 4 years) loved walking to the beach and enjoying the lake. Breathtaking panoramic views from the 4th floor! We fished, kayaked, and surfed the waves." – August B. "Great location and plenty of space for our family! Would highly recommend for a relaxing stay near the beach." – Amir R. "Beautiful home with lots of space and attentive management. Loved the short walk to the beach and the included bikes!" – Maegan K.*** LIVING AREA ***Expansive main living area featuring plush, comfortable sofas bathed in natural lightCozy separate sitting nook, perfect for reading, relaxing, or intimate conversationsStunning lakefront balcony with high-top seating, ideal for enjoying sunset drinks and breathtaking views*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Premium stainless steel appliances, featuring a high-performance gas range and double ovens for all your cooking needsSpacious dining table with seating for 8, complemented by 4 stylish barstools at the center island for casual gatheringsPrivate balcony with stunning lake views, equipped with a propane grill for unforgettable al fresco dining experiences*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Luxurious heated pool and spa overlooking serene lakefront views—your private oasis awaitsPropane barbecue grill for outdoor cooking and dining with family and friendsCozy fire pit area with ample seating, ideal for stargazing nights or roasting marshmallows with loved onesExclusive private dock perfect for fishing, kayaking, or relaxing under the sun in complete tranquility*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st FloorBunk Room: Custom-built Queen-over-Queen bunk beds and a Twin daybed, offering direct access to the pool and patio for ultimate convenience and relaxation.King Guest Suite: Luxurious King bed with a private En-suite bathroom, a handy kitchenette, and direct pool access—perfect for guests seeking privacy and comfort.2nd FloorPowder Room & Mudroom: Equipped with a washer and dryer for effortless convenience, all strategically located to keep things tidy and accessible.3rd FloorPrimary Suite: Indulge in a King bed with a private balcony offering breathtaking Gulf views. The En-suite features double vanities, a soaking tub, and a spacious walk-in shower for a spa-like retreat.Two King Guest Suites: Both rooms feature King beds, a shared En-suite bathroom, and private lakefront balconies for tranquil mornings with stunning views.4th FloorBunk Area: Twin-over-Full bunk bed, perfect for kids or extra guests, alongside a spectacular wraparound balcony. Enjoy panoramic views that make this space truly unforgettable*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Seagrove Beach Access Points - Just a 3-minute walk away, you’ll find easy access to pristine beaches where you can unwind and enjoy the sound of crashing waves.Old Florida Fish House - A 4-minute ride takes you to this laid-back spot, perfect for enjoying fresh seafood and soaking up the quintessential coastal charm.Eastern Lake - Access serene coastal dune lake right off your back door, ideal for fishing, kayaking, and paddleboarding in a peaceful, natural setting.Seaside Beach - Just a 10-minute drive away, this iconic beach town offers white sandy shores, unique shops, and a vibrant, relaxed atmosphere that feels straight out of a movie.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Pool/Spa heating available for an additional fee + tax. Can only be heated between Sept 1–April 30.There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the entrance door of the home.Waiver required to get access to the 7 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.The indoor fireplace and the garage are not for guest use.IMPORTANT NOTICE: CONSTRUCTION IN THE AREAPlease note that construction is ongoing throughout the 30A area, and we are unable to guarantee the absence of construction near the property. Currently, there is active construction taking place next door, with an unknown completion date. We appreciate your understanding and patience as the area continues to develop.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***
